description: Strategy-as-Indicator Toggles (LIT X + SMT on chart) - Add litX, smt, tradePro toggles to IndicatorToggles, add chips in IndicatorPanel, compute LitX/SMT in ChartViewModel when toggled, create ChartSignalLayer with DrawScope.drawLitXSignals and DrawScope.drawSmtDivergences, gate all strategy overlays on their respective toggles.
steps: Add fields to IndicatorToggles: litX: Boolean = false, smt: Boolean = false, tradePro: Boolean = true
Add 'LIT X', 'SMT', 'TradePro' Chip entries in IndicatorPanel.kt with toggle callbacks
Add to ChartUiState: litXAnalysis: LitXAnalysis? = null, smtDivergences: List<SmtDivergenceDetector.SmtDivergence> = emptyList()

In ChartViewModel, inject LitXEngine and SmtDivergenceDetector. In processCandles (or ChartIndicatorCoordinator), compute LitX analysis when toggles.litX is true (like tradeProAnalysis computation), and compute SMT divergences when toggles.smt is true

Create feature/chart/presentation/components/layers/ChartSignalLayer.kt with: DrawScope.drawLitXSignals(analysis: LitXAnalysis, viewport, cw, ch) - draws entry/SL/TP lines + direction arrow when a validated signal exists; DrawScope.drawSmtDivergences(divergences, candles, viewport, cw, ch) - draws divergence markers (circles at primary swing index with connecting dashed line to peer index level)
Invoke drawLitXSignals and drawSmtDivergences in CandleChart.kt gated by if (litXAnalysis != null && toggles.litX) and if (smtDivergences.isNotEmpty() && toggles.smt) respectively
Gate existing tradeProAnalysis rendering (drawTradeProOverlays in CandleChart) on toggles.tradePro
Update ChartUiStateMapper.withComputation to include litXAnalysis and smtDivergences in the state copy
acceptance_criteria: IndicatorToggles has litX, smt, tradePro fields with correct defaults
IndicatorPanel shows chips for LIT X, SMT, TradePro
ChartUiState has litXAnalysis and smtDivergences fields
ChartViewModel computes LitX and SMT when their toggles are enabled
ChartSignalLayer.kt contains drawLitXSignals and drawSmtDivergences extension functions
CandleChart invokes signal layer functions gated on toggle state
TradeProOverlays rendering is gated on toggles.tradePro
verification: Source-level verification: confirm new toggle fields, chip entries, computation logic, layer file existence and invocation in CandleChart
